description: Implementation of a PHP stream class (Stream) that adheres to the StreamInterface, providing methods for stream handling such as read, write, seek, and metadata retrieval within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 library.

classes.name: Stream
classes.description: A class implementing a PHP stream, providing methods for stream manipulation and metadata access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a Stream object wrapping a resource with optional size and metadata.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Closes the stream when the object is destructed.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the stream contents as a string, seeking to the beginning if seekable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads and returns the remaining contents of the stream.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying resource from the stream object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is seekable.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the stream is at end-of-file.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream to the beginning.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specific position in the stream.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the stream.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or specific key if provided.
